# H2O.ai Benchmarks

> Where H2O.ai's AI systems place on public leaderboards run by other organizations. A standing is read from the organizer's own board, and a line says so when H2O.ai derived the rank from the organizer's data or the result is H2O.ai's own run. Every rank names the population it is counted in, and where H2O.ai's statement and the organizer's data differ, the organizer's data is the source.

The page at https://h2oai.github.io/benchmarks/ draws its tables and charts in the browser from the same data. This file and the CSV files below give it as plain text. A date is the day the board was read; a board changes after that day.

## Benchmarks

- [JevBench](https://benchmarkheaven.com/jev-models): Decision models get a situation and typed questions and must return calibrated answers. Scored on intelligence, calibration, speed and cost; open-weights systems are ranked on their own board. Read 2026-11-24.
  - H2O-Lightning-31B ranks #3 of 251 on JevBench Capability, the board's headline score. Population: Systems inside the board's cost and latency caps, as listed in its Capability table.
  - H2O-Lightning-4B ranks #4 of 269 on the JevBench Composite score for open-weights systems. Population: Ranked open-weights systems on the live board. Hosted API offerings are listed for comparison but not ranked.
- [ImageJevBench](https://benchmarkheaven.com/image-jev-bench): Image decision models get a picture and typed questions and must return calibrated answers. Scored on intelligence, calibration, speed and cost; the Capability score, the board's headline, averages intelligence and calibration for the systems inside its cost and latency caps. Read 2026-11-24.
  - H2O-Lightning-31B ranks #1 of 56 on ImageJevBench Capability, the board's headline score. Population: Jev-class systems on the core track: inside the board's official cost and latency caps, as listed in its Capability table.
- [ImageJevBench Box Track](https://benchmarkheaven.com/image-jev-bench#box-track): Box questions show one image and a short description, such as the signature field or the rightmost truck, and the model answers with a bounding box and a confidence. Scored on Box Intelligence (mean IoU), Acc@0.5 and Calibration; the Box Capability score, the track's headline, is the mean of Box Intelligence and Calibration. Read 2026-11-24.
  - H2O-Lightning-4B ranks #3 of 20 on the ImageJevBench Box track (preview). Population: Ranked systems on the Box track, a preview track: the board scores it on its public items and holds its sealed items back for official runs. It does not change ImageJevBench's core ranking.
- [fev-bench](https://huggingface.co/spaces/autogluon/fev-bench): Zero-shot forecasting on real time series across many domains and frequencies, scored by probabilistic accuracy (scaled quantile loss) and summarized as win rate and skill score against a seasonal-naive baseline. Read 2026-11-24.
  - TimeH2O-v1 ranks #2 of 36 on the fev-bench leaderboard, by win rate. Population: The leaderboard's default view: the full task set, SQL, pretrained, task-specific and statistical models with non-commercial models included; closed-API models excluded. Rank derived by H2O.ai: fev.analysis.leaderboard definition (SQL vs Seasonal Naive, clipped, baseline imputation, Chronos-Bolt leakage imputation) recomputed from the organizer's CSVs.
- [Social Simulation Arena](https://social-simulation-arena.com/#leaderboard): Entrants forecast the next public release of poll, sentiment and attention series. Forecasts are locked before the answer exists and scored against the published number, relative to simply copying the last release. Read 2026-11-24.
  - H2O AI Super Agent ranks #1 of 22 on Social Simulation Arena's Season 0 pairwise win rate. Population: The site's default view: the Season 0 window (every question type locked from its start), one row per method, ranked by pairwise win rate. The arena-score views are listed beside it.
  - H2O AI Marina ranks #3 of 22 on Social Simulation Arena's Season 0 pairwise win rate. Population: The site's default view.
- [FutureX](https://futurex.live/): Agents predict real-world events before they resolve, with a new board every week that is scored once the answers are known. Harder question levels carry more weight. Read 2026-11-24.
  - H2O AI Super Agent ranks #5 of 46 on FutureX's weekly board for 2026 Nov. Week 1. Population: Every submission on the weekly board for November 2026, week 1 (FutureX numbers weeks within the month).
  - 26 medals on the 46 weekly boards entered (2025 Oct. Week 3 – 2026 Nov. Week 1): 9 first, 10 second and 7 third places, counting every H2O entry. Population: Every H2O submission on every weekly board the agent entered, ranked by the board's own score order; each submission placed first, second or third counts as a medal, so one board can add more than one.
- [TALENT](https://github.com/LAMDA-Tabular/TALENT): A public benchmark suite of tabular classification and regression datasets. Here: TabH2O against other tabular foundation models, AutoML and tuned gradient-boosting baselines. Read 2026-11-24.
  - TabH2O ranks #5 of 13 on TALENT. Population: The comparison set on the TALENT datasets, with a single TabH2O entry: other tabular foundation models, AutoML and tuned gradient-boosting baselines. Basis: H2O.ai's own run. Rank derived by H2O.ai: Per task, rank completed runs (ties share the best rank); average over tasks; order by the average - the method of H2O's own report for this suite.
- [TabArena](https://tabarena.ai): A public benchmark suite of tabular datasets with a living leaderboard. Here: TabH2O against other tabular foundation models and tuned baselines on the TabArena datasets. Read 2026-11-24.
  - TabH2O ranks #7 of 39 on TabArena. Population: The comparison set on the TabArena datasets, with a single TabH2O entry: other tabular foundation models and tuned baselines. Basis: H2O.ai's own run. Rank derived by H2O.ai: Per task, rank completed runs (ties share the best rank); average over tasks; order by the average - the method of H2O's own report for this suite.
- [EnergyBench by Foretec](https://energybench.foretec.co/): A live, open benchmark of day-ahead electricity forecasting: every day before the auction gate, each entry forecasts price, wind, solar and load for the next delivery day in six European bidding zones from one frozen set of public inputs, and is scored against the grid operators' own actuals. Read 2026-11-24.
  - TimeH2O-v1 ranks #1 of 40 on EnergyBench's standings over all targets. Population: the board's standings for all six zones and all four targets (price, wind, solar and load), rated over all 53 live issue days (2026-10-02 to 2026-11-24); covariates all, ensembles excluded, series combined by the mean; the backtest is not in it

## Data

- [All boards in one CSV](https://h2oai.github.io/benchmarks/data/h2o-benchmarks.csv): every row of every board the page shows, with H2O.ai's entries marked, the board's own score and direction, and the day the board was read.
